decisions.reason: The 45-degree spacing concerns the welded lug hole axes and does not change the bushing location, clearance, rod guidance, or sliding-end arrangement.
The geometry change does not alter the obligation to deliver a 3D model or its required file formats.
The specified hole-axis angle does not change the drawing template, presentation setup, or assembly-based numbering convention.
The source establishes lug geometry but does not explicitly require a new or changed drawing annotation, and the candidate has no established annotation attributes to modify at this time.
The lug geometry clarification does not change the requirement to provide the manufacturing drawing set itself.
